method: Direct view_image inspection of screenshots captured from localhost:6001 after UAT086 deployment

reviewed.observation: English Review return intent is the first card element above the registration title; text and compact mobile layout are clear with no clipping.
Chinese Library return intent is the first card element above the registration title; localized controls fit the mobile viewport.
The safe wrong-current-password error is crisp inside the active dialog; fields, helpers, notice, and footer actions remain distinct and fit without overlap.
Chinese Change password title, field labels, helpers, session notice, and actions render cleanly in the deployed candidate.

locale_method_limit: The Chinese account-dialog presentation check intercepted only the locale-persistence PUT after the client changed language, so the existing account preference remained unchanged. This validates deployed localized presentation, not backend locale persistence; that behavior is outside this non-mutating smoke and has separate QA coverage.
scope_limit: These captures support the bounded UAT086 smoke and are not a full-site visual or real-device Safari certification.
